summary: PJM's emergency procurement for a projected 6,831 MW shortfall for 2028/29, with contracts of up to 15 years, had been set to accept offers Sept 30 to Oct 21, 2026 and has been delayed. The July board package also proposed a mandatory registry of large loads subject to curtailment during system stress.

source.citation: Utility Dive; PJM reliability backstop workshop materials

confidence_note: Delay reported; filing and new schedule not read.
